scripts.features:
🔥 NEMo Hub | Feature Overview | Mobile📱 And PC 💻
👻 ULTIMATE STEALTH
"INVISIBLE👻👻👻 (Dylanscripts_ Style 99%)": The crown jewel of this script. It uses a high-tier Seat-Weld bypass that desyncs your character from the server. You can move freely while your "hitbox" remains safely hidden, making you nearly impossible to detect or hit—exactly like the famous Dylanscripts_ method. 🔥
🚀 MOVEMENT & PHYSICS
Speed & Jump: Precision sliders to override your default walk speed and jump height.
Fly / Vehicle: A dual-purpose flight engine. It works for your character and can also be used to fly cars or other vehicles.
Infinite Jump: Removes the jump cooldown, allowing you to climb to the top of the map by spamming space.
Noclip: Disables all collisions, letting you walk through walls, doors, and floors.
Pass Through: Specifically designed to ignore player collisions, preventing others from "flinging" or pushing you.
👁️ VISUALS & WORLD
ESP Name: Draws clear text tags over every player’s head, allowing you to track enemies and friends through solid objects.
Fullbright: Forcefully sets the game’s world lighting to maximum. It removes shadows and makes dark maps crystal clear.
No Fog: Clears out atmospheric fog, giving you an infinite view distance.
Streamer Mode: Designed for recording, it hides sensitive UI elements to protect your identity.
☁️ UTILITIES & CLOUD TOOLS
Freecam: Decouples the camera from your body. You can fly the camera around the map to scout areas while your character stays safely anchored.
Air Block: Creates an invisible platform under your feet. It tracks your movements perfectly, effectively allowing you to "walk on air."
Music Injector: Allows you to play any Roblox Sound ID. It attaches the audio to your character so others (in some games) can hear your vibe.
Admin Detector: An automated security guard. It constantly scans the server for staff members or creators and alerts you immediately if you are being watched.
🛠️ INTERFACE CONTROL
Menu and button opacity: A unified slider that controls the transparency of both the background and the functional buttons for a sleek, "glass" look.
Menu Size: Scales the entire GUI to fit perfectly on any screen, from small phones to large monitors.
